title: TDS on Net Winnings from Online Games
plainTextSummary: Mandates 30% TDS on net winnings in any user account of online gaming platforms, computed at the time of withdrawal or at the end of the financial year under Rule 133.

keyStatutoryThresholds.label: Minimum Monetary Threshold
keyStatutoryThresholds.statutoryBasis: Section 194BA(1) (Taxable on first rupee of net winnings)
